title: BWSSB Rainwater Harvesting & Groundwater Recharge Incentive Scheme
publisher: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB)
gazette_reference: Karnataka Gazette Notification No. UDD 42 MBD 2026
summary: Financial rebate and tariff incentive for registered Apartment Owners Associations (AOAs) and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs) in Bengaluru installing compliant rooftop rainwater harvesting, groundwater recharge pits, and dual-piping water efficiency fixtures.
amount_rules: Capital subsidy of 50% of audited installation cost, capped at INR 250,000 (25,000,000 paise). Additional 5% water supply cess rebate for two financial years.
required_documents: RWH and Recharge Well Completion Certificate
permission: Government of Karnataka Open Data Initiative; published for public distribution; permitted for offline pilot ingestion.
